QuestInfo.name: The Demon's Betrayer
QuestInfo.0: You learned about the mission to rendezvous with Hideyoshi, but the generals still have not reached a consensus. If only Haruaki would sort this out...
QuestInfo.1: Tsuchimikado Haruaki stepped in to break the stalemate, siding in favor of the proceeding with the meeting. Meet with Kenetsugu, Yukimura, and Yukimori at the Eastern Honnou-ji walls and talk to Hideyoshi.
QuestInfo.2: Hashiba Hideyoshi, one of Nobunaga's generals, was waiting for you when you reached the eastern Honnou-ji walls.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 6,348,411\nCan proceed to the Questionable Allegiance quest

default.0: Rendezvous with Hashiba Hideyoshi outside the Eastern Honnou-ji wall.
